findings.issue: Validated downstream arrays default to empty when an existing snapshot is retained. With international sources skipped, failed or empty, international.json keeps valid old events but summary/network are overwritten as empty and rollup omits them. Both scopes also lose retained events when all fresh candidates fail validation; initialize from validated retained snapshots and clear only on explicit clearing.

The new fallback count comparison is nested under count > 0. A stale deterministic brief claiming one or more events passes the audit when the actual incident count is zero, despite violating issue #80 count equality. Apply the comparison to both scopes even at zero.

summary: Fixed two defects: retained validated snapshots now feed rollup/network/summary, and fallback count mismatches are rejected even for zero incidents. Eight regression cases were proven red-to-green; final Git Bash checks pass 1055 Vitest tests, five Python tests, typecheck and build. Fixes are local; no push or deployment.
